npcs.name: TzTok-Jad
npcs.notes: Levels, max hits, size, speed and the +60 magic attack bonus from the wiki. Melee is instant (no warning) and only used in melee range. Like every monster, he holds still while an attack of his can reach the player, so with 15-tile ranged and magic he does not walk to approach. Ranged (stomp, 2652) and magic (rear-up, 2656) start their animation 3 ticks before the roll; the protection prayer is read at the roll, so the player switches while Jad winds up. The 3-tick window is a tuning choice: the wiki gives no tick count. Below 150 hitpoints he calls four Yt-HurKot; if they heal him back to full, the dead ones come again the next time he falls below 150. Graphics: 451 (rocks dropped on the player by the stomp), 448 (fireball), 157 (its splash). Sounds: 159 (firebreath) as the magic wind-up starts and 410 (dragon_hit) when he is hit, both per the wiki. The ranged stomp is 163 (firewave_hit), heard on the roll tick rather than at the wind-up, identified by ear by the user. His melee (408 dragon_attack) and death (409 dragon_death) are the chromatic dragons' sounds, which he shares with them (the user's knowledge; ids from the wiki's List of sound IDs, next to 410 dragon_hit).

npcs.name: Yt-HurKot
npcs.notes: Fight Cave numbers from the wiki: a flat 5 hitpoints every 4 ticks within 5 tiles (Mod Ash). Attacking one distracts it: it fights back and stops healing, until the player is far away (the 8-tile leash is a guess; the wiki only says it gives up quickly). Animations 2637 (attack: a lunge), 2635 (block: a brief guard), 2638 (death: falls) and 2639 (heal: raises an arm high, toward Jad) were picked from side-on silhouettes (npc_anim_probe STRIP=...), not from the game itself. Sounds: the tzhaar_hur_* set (251, 253, 252), a guess from the name.
